diagnosis: WalletDebitTransferView deducts funds from a MultiCurrencyWallet using django-money's Money field. The lookup MultiCurrencyWallet.objects.filter(id=wallet_id, balance_currency=currency) validates that the wallet matches the requested currency code, but fails to check that wallet.owner == request.user. An authenticated attacker can supply any user's wallet_id to drain funds from another account.
